reason: I would let my admin try the free 30, it costs nothing, but in a café that is gone in a week and I already pay someone to do the spreadsheet. My staff send photos to the group when they remember, and I don't believe they will change how they work just because there is a bot now.
objection: After the free part the staff stop forwarding to the bot, my admin goes back to her own Excel, and I end up paying every month for a sheet nobody looks at.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free documents my staff are still sending receipts to the bot on their own and my admin tells me the sheet matches what she would have typed, then I pay for the 200 plan.
